description: This file defines the data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to 'zone changed' events in a device service API, including creation, cloning, copying, destruction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and associated constants.

classes.name: ZoneChanged
classes.description: Structure representing a zone change event with fields for display index, label, faulted/bypassed/bypassActive flags, event ID, and reason.

methods.name: zoneChangedCreate
methods.description: Creates a new immutable zone changed event with specified parameters.

methods.name: zoneChangedClone
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing zone changed event.

methods.name: zoneChangedCopy
methods.description: Copies data from one zone changed event to another safely.

methods.name: zoneChangedDestroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a zone changed event.

methods.name: zoneChangedDestroy__auto
methods.description: Automatically destroys and frees a zone changed event pointer.

methods.name: zoneChangedToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a zone changed event to a JSON string.

methods.name: zoneChangedFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a zone changed event.
